common.linkCopy: Button not working? Paste this into your browser:
common.securityNoticeReason: You're getting this because a ReactionLab account uses this address. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

repeatedRegistration.title: Someone tried to sign up with your email
repeatedRegistration.attempt: Someone just tried to create a ReactionLab account with {email}. You already have an account with this address, so nothing was created and nothing about your account changed.
repeatedRegistration.ifItWasYou: If it was you, sign in instead. Forgotten your password? The sign-in page can send you a link to reset it.
repeatedRegistration.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, you don't need to do anything. Your account is safe, and nobody can use your address for another ReactionLab account.

emailConfirmation.title: Confirm your email address
emailConfirmation.ownership: Confirm that {email} is yours, and you can sign in and start experimenting.
emailConfirmation.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
emailConfirmation.ifItWasNotYou: Didn't sign up? Ignore this email. Nobody can sign in with this address until it's confirmed.
emailConfirmation.reason: You're getting this because someone signed up for ReactionLab with this address.

passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.request: Someone, hopefully you, asked to reset the password of your ReactionLab account.
passwordReset.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.
passwordReset.ifItWasNotYou: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email: your password stays the same, and nobody can use the link without this mailbox.
passwordReset.reason: You're getting this because someone asked to reset the password of the ReactionLab account at this address. It's a security email, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.changed: The password of your ReactionLab account was just changed, and every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.ifItWasYou: If this was you, there's nothing else to do.
passwordChanged.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't, reset your password now. The link in that email signs out whoever changed it.
passwordChanged.reset: It wasn't me: reset my password
passwordChanged.reason: You're getting this because the password of the ReactionLab account at this address changed. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

signInMethodChanged.ifItWasYou: If this was you, there's nothing else to do.
signInMethodChanged.reset: It wasn't me: reset my password
signInMethodChanged.reason: You're getting this because the sign-in methods of the ReactionLab account at this address changed. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

connected.title: {provider} sign-in was connected to your account
connected.changed: You can now sign in to ReactionLab with {provider}.
connected.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, sign in, disconnect {provider} in Settings › Sign-in methods, and change your password.

disconnected.title: {provider} sign-in was disconnected from your account
disconnected.changed: You can no longer sign in to ReactionLab with {provider}, and every other device was signed out.
disconnected.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, reset your password now: the link in that email signs out whoever changed it. Then connect {provider} again.

passwordSet.title: A password was added to your account
passwordSet.changed: You can now sign in to ReactionLab with your email address and this password. For its first 7 days it can't be used to remove your other ways to sign in.
passwordSet.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, sign in another way and remove the password in Settings › Sign-in methods. That signs out every other device.

passwordRemoved.title: The password was removed from your account
passwordRemoved.changed: You can no longer sign in to ReactionLab with a password, and every other device was signed out.
passwordRemoved.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, reset your password now: the link in that email lets you choose a new one and signs out whoever removed it.

takenOver.title: {provider} sign-in now opens your account
takenOver.changed: Someone had signed up with your address without ever confirming it. Signing in with {provider} proved the address is yours, so their password and sign-in methods were removed and every device they used was signed out.
takenOver.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, someone else is signed in to your {provider} account. Secure it with {provider} first, then review your sign-in methods here.

signInLocked.reason: You're getting this because signing in to the ReactionLab account at this address was paused after wrong passwords. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

paused.title: Password sign-in was paused on your account
paused.happened: Someone, maybe you, typed a wrong password for your ReactionLab account too many times in a row, so signing in with the password was paused.
paused.ifItWasYou: If it was you, sign in again once the pause is over, or reset your password, which ends it at once.
paused.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, nobody got in: the pause is what stops the guessing. A long password you use nowhere else keeps it that way.

disabled.title: Password sign-in is turned off on your account
disabled.happened: After {count} wrong passwords in a row, signing in to your ReactionLab account with the password is turned off until you reset it. Other ways to sign in, such as Google, still work.
disabled.ifItWasYou: If it was you, reset your password to turn password sign-in back on.
disabled.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, nobody got in. Resetting your password turns password sign-in back on and starts the count again.

passwordChecksLocked.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, someone may be using your Google account on a shared computer. Sign out of Google there, then end your other sessions in Settings › Devices.
passwordChecksLocked.reason: You're getting this because password checks on the ReactionLab account at this address were paused after wrong passwords. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

paused.title: Password checks were paused on your account
paused.happened: A session that signed in to your ReactionLab account without the password, for example through Google, typed a wrong password too many times, so such sessions couldn't check your password for a while.
paused.ifItWasYou: If it was you, wait for the pause to end, or sign in with your password, which this pause doesn't affect.

disabled.title: Password checks are turned off on your account
disabled.happened: After {count} wrong passwords, sessions that signed in to your ReactionLab account without the password can no longer check it until you reset your password.
disabled.ifItWasYou: If it was you, reset your password to turn the checks back on.

platformAdminChanged.everyAdmin: Every platform admin hears of each change to who is an admin.
platformAdminChanged.ifUnexpected: If nobody on your team made this change, an admin account may be in the wrong hands. Review the platform roles now.
platformAdminChanged.reason: You're getting this because you are or were a platform admin of ReactionLab. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

granted.title: A platform admin was added
granted.changed: {account} is now a platform admin of ReactionLab.

revoked.title: A platform admin was removed
revoked.changed: {account} is no longer a platform admin of ReactionLab.

schoolAdminChanged.everyAdmin: Every admin of {organization} hears of each change to who its admins are.
schoolAdminChanged.ifUnexpected: If nobody at your school made this change, tell your school's other admins right away.
schoolAdminChanged.reason: You're getting this because you are or were an admin of {organization} on ReactionLab. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

deleted.title: An admin's account was deleted at {organization}
deleted.changed: An account that was {role} at {organization} was deleted, with everything it held.

imported.title: {count} admins were added at {organization}
imported.changed: {count} accounts are now {roles} at {organization}, among them {account}.

schoolInvitation.title: You're invited to {organization} on ReactionLab
schoolInvitation.firstAdmin: The ReactionLab team set up {organization} and made you its first admin.
schoolInvitation.chooseUsername: Your school account is ready for you to set up: you'll choose your username and your password.
schoolInvitation.choosePassword: Your school account is ready for you to set up: your username is {username}, and you'll choose your password.
schoolInvitation.expiry: The invitation works once and expires on {date}.
schoolInvitation.ifUnexpected: Not expecting this? Ignore it, or ask your school. Nothing happens until someone sets the account up.
schoolInvitation.reason: You're getting this because a school admin at {organization} invited this address. Questions about your school account go to your school.
schoolInvitation.firstAdminReason: You're getting this because ReactionLab set up {organization} with this address for its first admin. Questions go to whoever arranged it at your school.

schoolPasswordReset.requestedTitle: Reset the password of your school account
schoolPasswordReset.resetTitle: Choose a new password for your school account
schoolPasswordReset.requested: Someone, hopefully you, asked to reset the password of your school account at {organization}.
schoolPasswordReset.resetByMember: {requester}, {role} at {organization}, reset the password of your school account. Choose a new one to sign in again.
schoolPasswordReset.resetBySchool: Your school, {organization}, reset the password of your school account. Choose a new one to sign in again.
schoolPasswordReset.resetByPlatform: The ReactionLab team reset the password of your school account at {organization}, because none of its admins could sign in. Choose a new one to sign in again.
schoolPasswordReset.expiresInHours: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.
schoolPasswordReset.expiresInMinutes: The link works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.
schoolPasswordReset.expiresOnDate: The link works once and expires on {date}. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.
schoolPasswordReset.ifItWasNotYou: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email: your password stays the same, and nobody can use the link without this mailbox.
schoolPasswordReset.questions: Questions about your school account go to your school's admins.
schoolPasswordReset.reason: You're getting this because the school account at {organization} with this address needs a new password. It's a security email, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.
